$comment: Cross-boundary parity fixture for the `agentTiers` merge delta (design D-1, D-4.3).
The client's `mergeRegistryForDisplay` (apps/web-ui) is a hand-copied twin of the
server's `mergeOverlay` (scripts/lib/model-profiles.ts) — this fixture is exercised by
BOTH sides (scripts/__tests__/model-profiles.test.ts and the apps/web-ui suites) and
both must produce byte-identical `expectedMergedAgentTiers` output from the same
Cases covered, one per agent key:
builder  — inherit one host (claude), override another (opencode: standard -> deep)
navigator — whole-agent null tombstone: removed entirely from the merged result
reviewer — host-level null tombstone: its only host key is removed, agent entry
survives as an empty object (deletion is scoped to the host key, not the
agent — mirrors mergeFlatMap's per-key tombstone semantics one level up)
planner  — a genuinely new agent the builtin never named, added wholesale by the
overlay (no agent list in the registry principle — this is opt-in data)
